title: Poetry Contest
body:
The Task Force has run a PBB CAG Poetry Contest in past years — the flyer is on file and ready to go if the contest runs again. Full rules, deadlines, and prize details aren't published online yet — contact the Task Force directly for current contest information:

- Phone: (989) 763-4423
- Mailing address: P.O. Box 172, St. Louis, MI 48880
